backend_smoke.purpose: generic embedding service check only; no excerpt, generation output, vector, or score retained

scorer.runtime_version_check: GET /api/version must equal the registered version
scorer.model_check: GET /api/tags must contain exactly one matching name and digest
scorer.metric: cosine similarity using finite float64 vectors, math.fsum accumulation, and result clamped to [-1, 1]
scorer.accepted_records: successful v2 records only; each pair must have exactly one old and one new output with matching base-model revision and adapter digest
scorer.interpretation_limit: embedding similarity is not semantic ground truth

temporal_limit.reason: score-blind D04 objective labels were frozen before this excerpt-selection task was dispatched, and a generic non-experimental model smoke preceded excerpt selection
temporal_limit.selector_access: the deterministic selector reads the frozen sample manifest and exact source trees only; it does not open any label or score artifact
temporal_limit.consequence: the current six-excerpt ledger and any resulting outputs are suitable for implementation audit or exploratory analysis only; confirmatory use requires a newly frozen unseen sample or explicit independent review
